Starry Night is lighter—about 1/5 with no persistent hostile markers within 250 units, though wanderers can intrude. Clear them, open the final chest first, then loot debris. Its guaranteed value is the Electronics Blueprint, Rotor Blueprint, 15 Armory Tokens, and a Frame Memory Module.
